title: Beyond the Monolithic Scheduler: Lightweight Adaptive Policy Switcher for Process Scheduling Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2511.11628v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern operating system process schedulers typically enforce a static, ``one-policy-fits-all'' design, which inevitably compromises performance under the highly dynamic and mixed workloads of contemporary edge systems. Transitioning to dynamic adaptation faces two fundamental challenges: scenario specific static policies lack robust runtime adaptability, whereas computationally intensive AI-assisted policies introduce unacceptable execution overhead for resource-constrained devices. To structurally resolve this dilemma, we propose the Lightweight Adaptive Policy Switcher (LAPS), a framework that dynamically switches between predefined expert policies, thus decoupling high frequency context switching from low-frequency policy transitions and amortizing transitional overheads. translated_title: 超越单体调度器：面向进程调度优化的轻量级自适应策略切换器
translated_abstract: 现代操作系统的进程调度器通常采用静态的“一种策略适用于所有场景”的设计，这在当代边缘系统高度动态且混合的工作负载下不可避免地损害了性能。向动态自适应转型面临两个根本性挑战：针对特定场景的静态策略缺乏稳健的运行时适应性，而计算密集型的AI辅助策略则会给资源受限的设备带来不可接受的执行开销。为了从结构上解决这一困境，我们提出了轻量级自适应策略切换器（LAPS），这是一个在预定义的专家策略之间进行动态切换的框架，从而将高频的上下文切换与低频的策略转换解耦，并摊销了转换开销。为了消除高昂的在线计算开销，LAPS通过离线准备阶段预先解决所有复杂的动态权衡，构建了一个严格超……
tldr: 本文提出轻量级自适应策略切换器LAPS，通过在预定义专家策略间动态切换并将繁重的动态权衡计算转移至离线阶段，在不引入AI辅助调度高开销的前提下，实现了对边缘系统动态混合工作负载的高效进程调度优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LAPS, a Lightweight Adaptive Policy Switcher that dynamically switches between predefined expert policies and offloads heavy dynamic tradeoff computations to an offline phase, achieving efficient process scheduling for dynamic edge workloads without the prohibitive overhead of AI-assisted schedulers.
